bibl.title: Rājavyavahārakośa
Rājakośanighaṇṭu
bibl.note: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19.

This is a lexicon of political and administrative terms. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 55.

Tanjore ms. 5029 notes that the work is attributed to a Raghnātha, but it is clear from the verses after the colophon that the author is Ḍhuṇḍirāja Vyāsa. Consequently, the work was probably composed around the middle of the 17th century. See A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19: vol. 9, p. 3381.
